title: How Colom Changed a Long Shot in Mississippi Into a Race Too Close to Call
summary: Scott Colom, a Democrat, ran a viral ad and courted Republicans at a Trump rally before winning virtually the same number of votes as Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith, a Republican.
